dataset_name: Breast Histopathology Images (Invasive Ductal Carcinoma - IDC Benchmark)
source_organization: Cruz-Roa et al. / Janowczyk et al. / Hugging Face
number_of_patients: Anonymized whole slide cohort (162 WSI patients)
selection_method: Integrity-filtered, hash-deduplicated stratified sample preserving natural IDC vs Non-IDC class ratio (70% Class 0: non_idc_or_benign / 30% Class 1: invasive_ductal_carcinoma) across 70/15/15 train/val/test split. Source represents breast IDC whole slide tissue patches (Cruz-Roa et al., Janowczyk et al.).

dataset_name: TCIA NSCLC-Radiomics (LUNG1 Cohort with GTV-1 Segmentation & Clinical Survival)
source_organization: The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) / MAASTRO Clinic / Farrell et al.
selected_size: 800 CT axial slices with paired binary GTV masks
selection_method: Complete contiguous volumetric series from representative clinical stages I-IIIb (LUNG1-001 through LUNG1-007) with paired expert manual 3D GTV-1 delineations, standard lung windowing [-1000, +400 HU], slice tumor area and 3D tumor volume calculations

dataset_name: INSPIRE Prospective Multi-Cancer ctDNA Longitudinal Cohort
source_organization: Pugh Lab, Princess Margaret Cancer Centre / Bratman, Yang et al. Nature Cancer (2020)
selected_size: 315 longitudinal records across 94 patients (1 exact duplicate record removed)
selection_method: Full prospective longitudinal series tracking mean ctDNA mutant molecules/mL, mean VAF %, baseline PD-L1 expression, RECIST 1.1 response, and overall survival outcome; strictly ordered chronologically
